purpose: Frozen chronological split governing every Shadow / Anti-Saw / EQCORR calibration on the canonical Hybrid tick book. Any tuning reads these boundaries; the holdout is opened exactly once, at the end.
timestamp_parse: ISO8601 required: manager closes are stamped on the bar boundary, protective exits carry fractional-second exchange tick time. Inferring one format silently NaTs every TP/SL exit.

purge.basis: Longest information horizon measured on this book: max hold 92.3h and max lifecycle-episode span 93.8h (both H4). 7 days clears the observed maximum with ~80% margin, so no training label's outcome window can reach into the next segment.

train.use: Optuna / CatBoost search space. Use purged walk-forward folds INSIDE this window; do not fit on it as one block.

validation.use: Model selection between candidates that already survived train folds. Repeated probing here erodes it into a second training set.

holdout.use: SEALED. One single evaluation of the one final configuration. Any second look invalidates it as an out-of-sample estimate.

statistical_power.note: 2x standard error on the holdout mean. Effects smaller than ~0.05 R cannot be distinguished from noise on this book, so candidate improvements below that threshold must not be declared wins. For scale: disabling the flip-close mechanism cost 0.125 R, comfortably detectable.

regime_check.detail: Expectancy is flat across all three segments (0.494 / 0.513 / 0.492), so no segment is unrepresentative of the others and the split does not itself advantage or handicap a candidate.

known_open_issues.eqcorr_blocked: shadow_economic_correlation reads multi_timeframe_synthesis (alignment_score, persistence_score, structural_rank, location_bias, synthesis_state) from the hard-coded production path data/cognition/multi_timeframe_synthesis.parquet, which holds 227 rows covering only 2026-05-02..2026-08-28. No research pack contains a synthesis memory. Running EQCORR before rebuilding it over the full span yields FIELD_NOT_AVAILABLE for ~85% of trades without erroring, and the feature then encodes the date rather than market structure.
known_open_issues.no_entry_time_in_trades: trades.jsonl has entry_ts=None; entry market time must be joined from positions.jsonl on position_id (status OPEN vs CLOSED).
known_open_issues.context_builder_nondeterminism: Auxiliary context fields differ between identical rebuilds while decision-critical fields (active_market_context, lifecycle_state) stay stable. Decisions are unaffected, but an Optuna study whose objective depends on auxiliary fields would not be reproducible.
